text.answer: Tahm Kench is a tank/support with health-scaling bonus magic damage. His attacks and Tongue Lash build stacks that enable a stun or enemy Devour, while Thick Skin supplies healing or a shield.
text.counterplay: Avoid repeated hits, dodge his tongue, and move away from his dive destination.

text.counterplay: Back away as stacks build and avoid letting him refresh them.

text.answer: Tongue Lash damages and slows the first enemy hit, healing Tahm Kench if it hits a champion. Against a champion with three stacks, it stuns and consumes the stacks; he can also cast Devour during the lash to pull that target in and swallow them.
text.counterplay: Dodge sideways or keep other enemy units in the tongue's path, especially when marked with stacks.

text.answer: Abyssal Dive channels before relocating Tahm Kench to a target area, dealing magic damage and knocking up and stunning nearby enemies. Its destination indicator becomes visible to enemies during the channel if they have sight of the area. Hitting a champion refunds part of its cooldown and mana cost.
text.counterplay: Move out of the destination area when the indicator appears and avoid clustering.

text.answer: Thick Skin stores part of incoming damage as grey health. When it is off cooldown, a break from taking damage lets him consume grey health to heal; activating it instead converts his current grey health into a temporary shield.
text.counterplay: Keep pressure when safe to delay his healing, and avoid committing damage into his temporary shield.

text.answer: Devour swallows a champion, making them untargetable while inside. Enemies require three An Acquired Taste stacks and are suppressed, while Tahm Kench is slowed and grounded; swallowed allies cannot act but gain a shield, and he gains movement speed and can carry them with Abyssal Dive. Regurgitate spits the champion in a chosen direction, dealing magic damage based on maximum health to enemies.
text.counterplay: Respect his swallow threat as stacks build, and account for his ability to carry a threatened ally to safety.
